_comment: Every comparator present on a rule must hold (they are ANDed), which is how
the warn tiers carry an upper bound so a full drawer fires `danger` only
knowledge/maintenance_thresholds.yaml is a human-readable mirror of this file;

thresholds.title: Waste drawer filling up
thresholds.detail: The drawer is nearly full. A tidy household empties it before it insists.
thresholds.action: Empty the waste drawer at your next convenience and seat a fresh liner.

thresholds.title: Waste drawer full
thresholds.detail: The drawer has reached capacity. The box will decline to cycle until it is emptied.
thresholds.action: Empty the waste drawer now, fit a new liner, and slide it home until it clicks.

thresholds.title: Litter running low
thresholds.detail: The globe is getting light on litter. A modest top-up keeps every cycle clean.
thresholds.action: Add fresh clumping litter up to the fill line inside the globe.

thresholds.title: Litter critically low
thresholds.detail: There is barely enough litter for a proper cycle. Your companion deserves better footing.
thresholds.action: Refill the globe with fresh litter to the fill line before the next visit.

thresholds.title: Several cycles since the last empty
thresholds.detail: The box has run a good many cycles since the drawer was last emptied. A refresh now avoids a surprise later.
thresholds.action: Consider emptying the waste drawer and starting the count fresh.
thresholds._note: Fed by the device's own cycles_after_drawer_full counter, which resets when the drawer is reset. An LR4 reports cycle_capacity around 14, so the old threshold of 40 could never fire once this metric stopped being a local row count.
